title: Old Testament Overview
content: The Old Testament contains the history, law, poetry, and prophecy of Israel. It records God's covenant relationship with His people and reveals His character, holiness, and promises. The Old Testament also prepares the way for the coming Messiah through prophecies and symbols that are fulfilled in Jesus Christ.

title: New Testament Overview
content: The New Testament focuses on the life, teachings, death, and resurrection of Jesus Christ and the spread of the gospel through the early Church. It explains salvation through faith in Christ and provides instruction for Christian life and doctrine.
